question: Which one of the following was the first Micro-finance initiative in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SEWA Bank.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Point__**

__
 
• Microfinance has a long and distinguished history in India.
 
• Introduced for the first time by the SEWA Bank, part of the Self Employed Women's Association (SEWA), in Gujarat in 1974.
 
• It has since become instrumental in extending financial services to many who remained excluded from the economic mainstream.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
